policies.decisionRule: Select exact familiar template with allowed method and full context. Unknown physiology can still permit a clearly labelled field-session target; unknown task calibration cannot. Absent harder-session calibration choose only independently admissible familiar easy alternative with explicit tradeoff, otherwise ASK.
policies.evidenceStatus: SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS_FOR_CONSTRUCT_SEPARATION_AND_REUSE; exact new family calibration not supplied
policies.essentialStimulus: Match actual target construct to session intent; an easy downgrade explicitly loses harder stimulus, never claims equivalence.
policies.nextCheck: Record executed same-method target/dose, actual effort, conditions and recovery; conflicting data invalidates target reuse, not repaired by averaging different constructs.
policies.fallback: ASK/HOLD/NOT_SUPPORTED_YET for uncalibrated task; familiar easy only when explicitly admissible and accepted.
